tools.name: tolk2go_search_support_knowledge
tools.description: Search approved Tolk2Go knowledge: FAQ answers, workflows such as the booking workflow, and domain cards such as booking status meanings. Translate the user's question to English before calling this tool. Use it before answering questions about booking steps, booking statuses, services, policies, ca

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_languages
tools.description: Step 1 of booking, no key needed. List the languages Tolk2Go interprets, with their IDs. Pass a language ID to tolk2go_interpreting_list_language_pairs.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_language_pairs
tools.description: No key needed. List the bookable language pairs (for example Arabic–Dutch) with the language_pair_id that availability search and create_booking need. Filter with a language_id from tolk2go_interpreting_list_languages to keep the list short.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_situations
tools.description: No key needed. List the situations (such as medical, legal, business or CBR exams) with the situation_id that availability search and create_booking need. Pick the one that matches the assignment. Situations with booking_flow catalog (such as CBR) book an item from tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_qualifications
tools.description: No key needed. List the qualification types the search page filters on (such as Sworn Interpreter) and their providers (such as a national register). Pass the IDs as qualification_nodes to tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability when the customer requires a sworn or otherwise qualified interpreter.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog
tools.description: No key needed. For a situation with booking_flow catalog (such as cbr): its groups and items with code, name, duration_minutes and fixed price (excl. and incl. VAT; null for items priced per hour plus travel). Match what the customer says (a code such as VEE, or a name) to an item and ask the custom

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_catalog_locations
tools.description: No key needed. The fixed exam locations (name, address, city, latitude, longitude) of a catalogue group with location_mode configured_locations, such as the CBR theory exam centres. Pick the one in the city the customer named (ask when there are several); search availability with its latitude and lo

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability
tools.description: No key needed. Search interpreters for one assignment with the same filters and results as the tolk2go.com search page. Returns interpreter IDs, ratings and prices (excl. and incl. VAT) plus paging. Search again immediately before tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking so the IDs and prices are current

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_list_bookings
tools.description: List this account’s interpreter bookings, optionally returning only changes after a timestamp or cursor.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_get_booking
tools.description: Read the authoritative owner-scoped booking, payment, change and next-action state.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_get_responses
tools.description: Poll which interpreters responded as available for an owned booking request, with their interpreter_id. An empty list means wait (see polling.recommended_after_seconds on the booking) and poll again. Next: tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking
tools.description: Create an owner-scoped interpreter request for one start and end time. First get the IDs with the discovery tools and run tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability immediately before this call. preferred_interpreter_ids are the interpreters (one or more, from that search) who are asked first; offer s

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection
tools.description: Read-only. The exact proposal that tolk2go_interpreting_select_interpreter would commit to for this interpreter: time, phone/video or on-site location, price incl. VAT, payment terms (deposit, deadline) and cancellation terms. Show it to the customer and get explicit approval before selecting.

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_select_interpreter
tools.description: Book an interpreter who responded as available. This commits the customer: only call it after showing tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection for the same interpreter and getting the customer’s explicit approval. If the result contains a payment URL, give it to the customer and poll tolk2go_interpret

tools.name: tolk2go_interpreting_request_change
tools.description: Submit supported changes through the existing customer approval flow.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "tolk2go_search_support_knowledge" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search approved Tolk2Go knowledge: FAQ answers, workflows such as the booking workflow, and domain cards such as booking status meanings. Translate the user's q…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
